title: View the screen of another Shellherd device
notice: Both devices sign in to the same rendezvous server. The picture travels encrypted directly between the devices; the server only sees connection data.
identityTemporary: Temporary device identity: this computer has no operating system key store. The fingerprint changes on the next start.
compared: I compared the fingerprint on the other device
waiting: Waiting for approval on the other device…

consent.title: Share your screen?
consent.body: {{name}} wants to view the screen of this device. Compare the fingerprint on the other device.
consent.linuxHint: On Linux, the Shellherd window also stays visible in the shared picture.

bar.viewing: Screen is being viewed by {{name}} · since {{time}}

ended.remote: The other device ended the connection.
ended.expired: The session expired after five minutes. Make a new request.
ended.locked: The connection ended because the vault was locked.
ended.declined: The other device declined the request.
ended.scope: Control is not supported yet. Only viewing is possible.

errors.unavailable: Remote access is not available in this build.
errors.stale: This action is out of date. Close the dialog and open it again.
errors.identity: The stored device identity is damaged or unreadable. It was not replaced.
